title: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service"

entities.name: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of 5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service
entities.description: Indicates the forbidden Tracking Area Identities to be stored in the list of 5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service. This IE is included only when the message is sent via satellite NG-RAN access.

entities.name: Message sent via satellite NG-RAN access
entities.description: Condition that the message is transmitted over satellite NG-RAN access technology.

entities.name: List of 5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service
entities.description: A stored list in the UE containing forbidden Tracking Area Identities for regional service provision.

relations.description: The inclusion of the Forbidden TAI(s) IE is conditional upon the message being sent via satellite NG-RAN access.
The Forbidden TAI(s) IE provides the TAI values to be stored in the list of 5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service.
